sources.title: Thomson-1.0-Small - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Thomson-1.0-Small is a frontier Foundation Model of high proficiency across a wide range of specialised and general-purpose domains as well as practical deployment settings. It is the open-weight member of the Thomson-1.0 family, developed within a Continual Learning paradigm with a deliberate focus on economically impactful, high-stakes professional work across legal, tax, and journalism ...
